A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work and contain 18 readable pages. Text, equations, tables, figures, and references support reliable comparison. Neither supplied PDF contains appendices.

before.justification: v1 reports theoretical algorithms, complexity bounds, and proofs, but no original experiments, simulations, user studies, or empirical data analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains the theoretical treatment and introduces no original empirical results.

M1.justification: The exact algorithm, treedepth and vertex-cover algorithms, reduction rules, and teaching-map constructions in Sections 2–4 are unchanged.

E1.justification: Neither version uses empirical datasets or evaluation tasks. The graph classes and theoretical problems considered remain unchanged.

E2.justification: Neither version experimentally evaluates comparison methods. The revised attribution in Table 1 concerns a theoretical complexity bound.

E3.justification: Neither version reports experimental protocols, training settings, data splits, or evaluation metrics.

E4.justification: Neither version contains empirical ablations, robustness tests, or error analyses. The illustrative graph constructions and proof case analyses are unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated runs, seeds, uncertainty estimates, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Table 1 replaces the NCTD+ Balls lower-bound entry 2^{o(f(k)(|V|+|E|))} (Theorem 3) with 2^{o(k*d*|V|)} [GKMR25]. This changes the summarized result entry; the replacement bound was already stated in both introductions, and no empirical performance or proved result changes.

T1.justification: The definitions, assumptions, theorem statements, lemmas, and proofs are unchanged. Table 1 switches between bounds already stated in v1, without introducing or revising a theorem or derivation.

C1.justification: Section 1.1 changes the claim that the positive bound improves NON-CLASH's lower bound to calling it a new strong bound. Section 2 correspondingly restricts the stronger-than-prior-work claim to N-NCTD instead of both variants.

C2.justification: The positive lower bound is no longer interpreted as necessarily strengthening the known NON-CLASH bound. Its claimed tightness for closed neighborhoods and the limitations and open questions in Section 5 remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Algorithmic descriptions are unchanged. Neither version adds implementation details, hardware information, experimental settings, or code and data access instructions.

R1.justification: v2 narrows its claimed improvement over prior NON-CLASH research and attributes Table 1's positive-balls lower bound to GKMR25 instead of Theorem 3. The cited works and bibliography otherwise remain unchanged.

P1.justification: Two short passages on page 3 are revised, and the arXiv version/date stamp changes. The abstract, conclusion, section organization, and remaining prose are unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 1 has a slight width and spacing adjustment accompanying the replaced entry. Its structure, caption, and placement remain unchanged, as do all eight figures.

improvement.justification: v2 more carefully distinguishes a new lower bound from an improvement over previously known bounds. The narrowed claims in Sections 1.1–2 and revised attribution in Table 1 improve the precision of research positioning, while leaving the algorithms, proofs, and scientific scope unchanged.
